sloka: कुशाम्बम् कुशनाभम् च आसूर्तरजसम् वसुम् ।दीप्ति युक्तान् महोत्साहान् क्षत्रधर्म चिकीर्षया ॥१-३२-३॥
transliteration: kuśāmbam kuśanābham ca āsūrtarajasam vasum ।dīpti yuktān mahotsāhān kṣatradharma cikīrṣayā ॥1-32-3॥

translations.english: Kusa addressed his four brilliant sons who were highly enthusiastic, pious, truthful and were wedded to duties of the warrior race:
